title: A safer way to cycle to school
situation: You are spending a year in a small town in England with your family because of your mother's job. Every day you cycle to school, but the road is busy and dangerous. Write an e-mail to the local council.
situationHu: Egy évig Angliában élsz a családoddal; az iskolába vezető út biciklivel veszélyes, ezért írj hivatalos e-mailt a helyi önkormányzatnak.

points.text: describe the road and explain why it is dangerous for cyclists
explain why many students would like to go to school by bike
suggest what the council could do to make the road safer

usefulPhrases.en: I am writing to tell you about a problem on … Road.
usefulPhrases.hu: Azért írok, hogy egy, a … Roadon lévő problémáról tájékoztassam Önöket.

usefulPhrases.en: There is heavy traffic in the mornings.
There is no cycle lane, so we have to ride next to lorries.

usefulPhrases.en: Cycling is cheaper, healthier and better for the environment.
